name: Kasukabe Haru
source:
Role: Fake Maid
Role in the Coμ: Mage

Haru is the oldest among the five people who control Babylon and is in-charge for its maneuvers. Her trademarks are huge breasts and housemaid uniform which she makes good use for her hobby - sex. Though she's not a real housemaid, she does however work at a maid café and Haru always wears the outfit no matter where she goes, even in public.
